title: Decision 3: a weight in GRAM on the frozen fish that the chain sells as a fixed pack
keys: Each product is keyed as it stood at the start of the stage of plan 0192 that changed it (the items-snapshot of that stage). A product that a stage created is keyed as the create answered it. Each queue row is keyed as it stood at the start of stage 1 (stage-c1/rows-snapshot.c0-start.json).
decidedBy: The owner, 2026-10-06 (decision 3). Plan 0192 reads "a round pack weight" as a multiple of 10 g or of 25 g, and writes a weight only when exactly one lies within 1 percent.
note: The price and the unit price are those of the first of the three Córdoba warehouses. The three agree on every product.
